title: Capital Q — further Qatari investors, researched public profiles (unclaimed)
purpose: Researched, unclaimed public profiles of Qatari investors beyond the Qatar five. Every fact cites its source with retrieval date, truth_class, evidence_status and an uncertainty label.
important_distinctions: QIA Fund of Funds invests in venture funds; a startup's route is a participating fund
Qatar Development Bank is a state development bank, not a private VC
Doha Tech Angels facts are from 2019 and need refreshing
No logins, mandates, quotes, decisions or endorsements for any real person or organisation
truth_axes_note: truth_class / evidence_status / lifecycle_status are separate axes (ADR-001). A public page is the entity's own or a reporter's statement (USER_CLAIM), never VERIFIED by Capital Q. No quotes, mandates, decisions or endorsements are attributed to any real person or organisation.

QI29.description: Qatar Development Bank news release: Startup Qatar Investment Program (22 Feb 2024)
QI29.excerpt: Qatar Development Bank has announced the launch of its Startup Qatar Investment Program … funding of up to $500,000 or 1.8 million Qatari riyals for startups looking to establish a presence in Qatar … up to $5 million or 18 million Qatari riyals for established global startups
QI29.title: Qatar Development Bank news release: Startup Qatar Investment Program (22 Feb 2024)

QI30.description: Gulf Times: QDB doubles investment packages (17 Nov 2025)
QI30.excerpt: I am pleased to announce the doubling of investment packages: up to QR4mn for seed stage companies and up to QR20mn for growth stage companies.
QI30.title: Gulf Times: QDB doubles investment packages (17 Nov 2025)

QI31.description: QNA interview with the QDB chief executive (3 Feb 2026)
QI31.excerpt: Since its launch, QDB's investment arm has committed around QR 390 million in direct and indirect venture investments. … the initiative has invested nearly QR 150 million in more than 40 start-ups from 15 countries
QI31.title: QNA interview with the QDB chief executive (3 Feb 2026)

QI33.description: Gulf Times: Fund of Funds aims to build bridges for startups (24 Feb 2025)
QI33.excerpt: In February 2024, QIA committed to invest USD 1 billion as part of the Fund of Funds program. … will invest more than USD 1 billion in international and regional venture capital funds … will place a priority focus on the tech and healthcare sectors.
QI33.title: Gulf Times: Fund of Funds aims to build bridges for startups (24 Feb 2025)
